languages_frameworks: FalkorDB (falkordb client >=1.7) with 59 named .cypher query files
LLM adapters: Anthropic, Ollama, Groq (tool-calling loop)

symbols: Q33 (variable-length CAN_GIVE_TO*1..3 with all(e IN relationships(path) ...))
implemented_capabilities.notes: Pure Cypher 2-way and 3-way cycle matching with id(a)<id(b) rotation dedupe and edge-status filters; bounded multi-hop reach with a depth cap. Cycle length is hard-capped at 3.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Expected-value loop selection (CP-SAT) and repair ranking
implemented_capabilities.notes: Set-packing CP-SAT model with one-loop-per-pair constraint, success probability product, 2-way fallback value, and lexicographic priority bonus; repair ranking is a deterministic sort. Real, not an LLM.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Decision lineage graph (Decision -BASED_ON-> facts, MADE_BY, APPROVED_BY) with human approval gate
implemented_capabilities.notes: Every agent action writes a Decision node with BASED_ON edges to the Loop/Failure/Offer it used and the memories read; repairs become an open Task assigned to a human and only execute on approve(); Loop -REPLACED_BY-> Loop records supersession.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Failure memory and local re-planning (invalidate edge, release nodes, repair only around the break)
implemented_capabilities.notes: A failed link is set e.status='failed', remembered as a (:Pair)-[:FAILED]->(:Pair) edge with a Failure node EVIDENCED_BY the Crossmatch test, the loop is marked broken, and pairs are released; later queries skip FAILED links. Dependency-invalidation pattern.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Supersedable semantic memory (Fact SUPERSEDES old Fact)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Old belief is kept with current=false behind a SUPERSEDES edge; findings link to the readings they used; answered questions are stored and recalled with dates.
UNION query flags a REPLACED_BY chain with no recorded human approval Decision, links with no recorded reasons, and stale status mismatches. Directly an approval-gating audit.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Withdrawal blast radius (what breaks if a node withdraws)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Lists every live loop a pair belongs to, co-members, and whether the stored FALLBACK_FOR loop survives without that pair; read-only Cypher.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Tool-calling Ask agent restricted to read-only named queries + MCP server
symbols: mcp tools: virtual_crossmatch, find_loops, explain_evidence, integrity_checks, add_pair
implemented_capabilities.notes: Real LLM tool loop but answers are constrained to graph-returned facts; write-detection is a regex over the .cypher text and FalkorDB GRAPH.RO_QUERY enforces it server-side. LLM quality depends on external provider.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Simulated lab, simulated hospital intake, synthetic personas and health watch
implemented_capabilities.notes: All patient/donor data and lab results are synthetic or simulated (stated in pyproject description and data/params); logic around them is real but domain data is demo.

graph_models_and_cypher: Labels: Pair, Donor, Patient, Hospital, HLAAntigen, Antibody, BloodGroup, Loop, Offer, Crossmatch, Failure, Decision, Agent, Task, Plan, Event, Person, Fact, Finding, Reading, Playbook, Question, LiverProfile. Edges: CAN_GIVE_TO (status/p_success/reasons/vxm), FAILED, IN_LOOP{pos}, FALLBACK_FOR, REPLACED_BY, BASED_ON, MADE_BY, APPROVED_BY, ABOUT, ASSIGNED_TO, EVIDENCED_BY, BROKE, SUPERSEDES, KNOWS, HAS_FINDING, TRIGGERED, ABO_OK, REACTS_WITH. Cypher uses FalkorDB-native features only (id(), ro_query, FOREACH, UNION, reduce, none/all, variable-length paths, timestamp()); no APOC or GDS. Per-tenant graphs via name prefix (db.real). Schema index creation in Q00_schema.cypher.
algorithms: 2-way/3-way directed cycle enumeration with id()-ordering dedupe (queries/Q04, Q05)
Bounded variable-length reachability, depth<=3, live edges only (queries/Q33_reachable_within.cypher)
CP-SAT weighted set packing with expected-value objective and priority tie-break (optimiser/solver.py:solve)
Expected value of a 3-cycle with embedded 2-cycle fallback (solver.py:expected_transplants, best_fallback)
Local repair ranking: keep-families-together then expected value then priority (solver.py:rank_repairs)
Edge invalidation + node release on failure, repair search only around released nodes (core.py:MatchingAgent.on_failure/rematch)
backend_interfaces: MCP stdio server backend/swapnet/mcp/server.py (FastMCP 'swapnet') exposing add_pair, virtual_crossmatch, components, find_loops, find_exchange_candidates, explain_evidence, program_rules, integrity_checks, run_lab_tests
frontend_interfaces: Next.js app router console pages: agents, ask, audit, committee, graph, impact, integrity, lab, patients, pool, swaps, case/[pair], families/[pair]
Components: AgentNetwork.tsx, ExchangeGraph.tsx, FamilyExplorer.tsx, FromMemory.tsx, PoolMap.tsx, TrendChart.tsx, StoryTour.tsx, Walkthrough.tsx
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Multi-agent coordination exclusively through graph state: Agent nodes (Matching agent, Crossmatch coordinator, Committee clerk, Patient liaison, per-hospital Intake agents, human coordinator). Hand-offs via Offer/Crossmatch/Task/Decision/Event nodes; Event feed with monotonic seq (db.event). Memory taxonomy (episodic/semantic/procedural/shared) with recall.item stored on each Decision/Finding showing which memories were read. Human-in-the-loop gate: Task(kind=approve_repair) must be approved by person before Loop REPLACED_BY edge is created. Chase ladder escalation in CommitteeClerk.chase.
tests_present: 13 pytest files under backend/tests (~79 test functions: test_agents, test_ask, test_chat, test_concurrency, test_demo_flow, test_explore, test_guards, test_liver_flow, test_personas, test_programs, test_reasoning, test_worlds_and_mcp, test_agents_page). Integration-style via FastAPI TestClient and require a live FalkorDB (test_guards.py docstring). Plus loadtest/ (artillery-style yml).
security_findings: backend/swapnet/access.py:51-59 - no authentication; identity is trusted from X-KindRed-User header (documented as demo only)

backend/swapnet/agents/core.py:51 - f-string builds Cypher with label and key interpolated (values are parameterised; label/key come from code constants, so low injection risk but pattern is unsafe if ever user-driven)
backend/swapnet/graph/db.py:133-139 - raw() executes arbitrary Cypher strings; used for write paths. Read-only enforcement for the Ask agent relies on regex at db.py:85-92 plus FalkorDB ro_query

backend/swapnet/voice.py:28-52 and backend/swapnet/agents/ask.py:436,504 - outbound HTTP to configurable URLs (SARVAM_URL, Ollama URL, Groq) with no allowlist (SSRF surface if env is attacker-controlled)
backend/swapnet/agents/core.py:499-503 - Task payload stored as json.dumps and re-read with json.loads (safe JSON, no pickle)
No hard-coded secrets found; keys read from env (.env.example has empty GROQ_API_KEY/SARVAM_API_KEY/FALKORDB_PASSWORD). No subprocess/eval/exec/pickle in backend/*.py.
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps blast-radius traversal (Q32 withdrawal impact, Q33 bounded reach), decision lineage / agent memory & provenance (Decision/BASED_ON/APPROVED_BY, SUPERSEDES), cycle detection (fraud rings / lineage cycles use the same Cypher cycle pattern), and operational optimisation (CP-SAT set packing).
evidence_drift_relevance: HIGH - implements decision lineage with BASED_ON/MADE_BY/APPROVED_BY, a human approval gate on Tasks, REPLACED_BY loop supersession, SUPERSEDES fact history with a current flag, failure edges that invalidate downstream loops, and an integrity query that flags replacements lacking recorded approval.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: A compact, working pattern for decision provenance + human approval gate + supersession + invalidation-on-failure, all on FalkorDB, which maps directly onto an Evidence Drift Cascade (evidence -> decision -> approval -> replaced-by).
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB only for the provenance/approval Cypher; OR-Tools only if the CP-SAT solver is reused; no LLM key needed for the lineage primitives

strategy_rationale: The kidney/liver swap domain is out of scope for Kairos, but the decision-lineage, approval-gate, supersession and integrity-audit primitives are domain-agnostic and FalkorDB-native, so they should be lifted into a shared provenance engine.
